Package index

Data Processing

Function to process survey data, including adding and inspecting variable and value labels.

dp_convert_to_labelled()
Convert a data frame to a labelled data frame using a codebook
dp_copy_codebook_template()
Copy a codebook template to a specified file path
dp_inspect_codebook()
Inspect the codebook of a labelled data frame
dp_label_automatically()
Automatically label a data frame
dp_recode_missing()
Recode user-defined missing values to NA

Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

Functions to perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) on survey data, including summary statistics, correlations, descriptive statistics, tests and plots of several variables by group (e.g. clusters), and an interactive Shiny gadget (eda_explore()).

eda_correlation()
Exploratory data analysis: correlation
eda_describe()
Exploratory data analysis: descriptive statistics of several variables
eda_explore()
Explore data interactively
eda_plot()
Exploratory data analysis: plot several variables in one plot
eda_plot_detail()
Exploratory data analysis: detailed plot of one variable by group
eda_summary()
Exploratory data analysis: Summary of data
eda_test()
Exploratory data analysis: test group differences of several variables

Key Driver Analysis (KDA)

Functions to perform KDA on survey data. kda_regression() is the main end-to-end function that runs the entire KDA process, while the other functions are helper functions that can be used to run specific steps of the KDA process.

kda_copy_pptx_template()
Copy PowerPoint template to specified file path
kda_data_is_haven_labelled()
Check whether all variables are haven-labelled and include variable/value labels
kda_forestPlot()
Create a forest plot for model coefficients
kda_importance_barPlot()
Create KDA importance bar plot
kda_importance_domir()
Perform KDA dominance analysis
kda_importance_jrw()
Calculate Importance using Johnson's Relative Weights
kda_importance_sumOfCoefficients()
Calculate feature importance using sum of coefficients
kda_interactive_workflow()
Conduct an interactive KDA workflow in the console
kda_ipma()
Importance-Performance Matrix Analysis
kda_ipma_scatterPlot()
Create an Importance-Performance Matrix Analysis scatter plot
kda_performance()
Calculate KDA performance
kda_performance_barPlot()
Create a KDA performance bar plot
kda_regression()
Conduct KDA regression analysis
kda_regression_with_imputation()
Conduct KDA with imputation of missing values
kda_save_data_for_chart()
Save KDA data for chart in Excel template

Price Sensitivity Meter (PSM)

Functions to perform Van Westendorp Price Sensitivity Meter Analysis, including the Newton Miller Smith Extension (NMS-Extension).

psm_copy_pptx_template()
Copy PowerPoint template to specified file path
psm_design_for_weighted()
Build a survey design object for weighted PSM analysis
psm_plot()
Plot Price Sensitivity Meter (van Westendorp) results
psm_save_data_for_chart()
Save PSM data for chart in Excel template

Segmentation (SEG)

Functions to perform segmentation (cluster analysis) on survey data: preparation of the data and distance matrices, assessment of the clustering tendency, number of clusters and choice of the algorithm, cluster analysis with different algorithms, returning standardized solutions with visualizations, and validation of the cluster solutions with internal measures (silhouette width, Dunn index) and external measures (agreement with a reference grouping).

seg_prep_data()
Prepare survey data for cluster analysis
seg_distance()
Compute a distance matrix for cluster analysis
seg_clustering_tendency()
Assess the clustering tendency of the data
seg_optimal_clusters()
Determine the optimal number of clusters
seg_nbclust_gap()
Optimal number of clusters: Gap statistic
seg_nbclust_indices()
Optimal number of clusters: NbClust indices
seg_nbclust_silhouette()
Optimal number of clusters: Average silhouette method
seg_nbclust_wss()
Optimal number of clusters: Elbow method (WSS)
seg_compare_algorithms()
Compare clustering algorithms
seg_cluster()
Cluster analysis (segmentation)
seg_cluster_density()
Density-based clustering: DBSCAN and HDBSCAN
seg_cluster_fuzzy()
Fuzzy clustering
seg_cluster_hierarchical()
Hierarchical clustering: AGNES and DIANA
seg_cluster_hkmeans()
Hierarchical k-means clustering
seg_cluster_model()
Model-based clustering
seg_cluster_partitioning()
Partitioning clustering: k-means and PAM
seg_dbscan_eps()
Choose eps for DBSCAN: k-nearest-neighbor distance plot
seg_as_cluster()
Convert an existing segmentation to a cluster solution
seg_plot_cluster()
Plot a cluster solution in the space of the principal components
seg_plot_dend()
Plot the dendrogram of a hierarchical cluster solution
seg_plot_heatmap()
Heatmap of a cluster solution
seg_plot_centers()
Plot the cluster centers of a solution
seg_validation()
Validate cluster solutions
seg_plot_silhouette()
Silhouette plot of a cluster solution
seg_agreement()
Agreement between cluster solutions
predict(<seg_cluster>) predict(<seg_cluster_set>)
Assign new respondents to the clusters of a solution

YouAnalyser (YA) Utility Functions

Miscellaneous utility functions for the YouAnalyser package.

ya_choose_file()
Choose a file and return its path
ya_choose_file_path()
Choose an existing directory and define a new file in this directory, returning the full file path
ya_save_plot()
Save a plot to JPEG
ya_setup_folder_structure()
Set up a standardized folder structure for a project
